rule.title: Canceled debt reaches the line its debt belongs to

citation.wording: You must report any taxable canceled debt as ordinary income on: • Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 8c, if the debt is a nonbusiness debt; • Schedule C (Form 1040), line 6, if the debt is related to a nonfarm sole proprietorship; • Schedule E (Form 1040), line 3, if the debt is related to nonfarm rental of real property;

rule.open_point: Farm debt (Schedule F, Form 4835) is out of scope and offered no line. A partial exclusion (insolvency to the extent insolvent) is Form 982 arithmetic and is not applied.
